facts.fact: Morocco signed early in 2026 a cooperation framework agreement for a digital wallet project with iDakto and ShareID as technology partners.
The Mon e-ID mobile application is already in use, per DGSN officials at the May 2026 DGSN Open Days in Rabat.
Mon e-ID is already in use to let citizens carry the digital version of their national ID card, per DGSN officials.

facts.fact: Morocco's biometric national ID card (CNIE) is renewed through DGSN enrolment offices where biometrics are captured, and the system is being upgraded.
